items.headline: RBI Rejects All Bids in T-Bill Auctions Signaling 'Calibrated Tightening'
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India rejected all 224 bids in three treasury-bill auctions for ₹23,000 crore, indicating a reluctance to signal higher short-term rates and aligning with its 'calibrated tightening' policy.

items.headline: RBI MPC Raises Repo Rate by 25 BPS to 5.5%, Shifts Stance Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee unanimously voted to increase the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% and moved its policy stance to 'calibrated tightening', driven by broadening inflationary pressures.

items.headline: Indian Banks Boost M&A Funding, Financing Up To 75% of Deal Values
items.summary: Indian banks are significantly increasing their participation in M&A financing, providing up to 75% of deal values, following the central bank's relaxation of financing rules, with the market estimated at nearly ₹2 lakh crore.

items.headline: Indian Market Eyes Cautious Opening on Weak Asian Cues and High Crude Oil Prices
items.summary: The Indian stock market is expected to open cautiously to negatively, influenced by weak Asian market performance, persistently high crude oil prices, and ongoing concerns about inflation and interest rates.

items.headline: Asian Markets Trade Lower Despite Wall Street Gains Amid AI Investment Concerns
items.summary: Most Asian indices, including South Korea, Hong Kong, and Japan, are trading lower due to concerns over AI investment costs, financing, and company earnings, despite an overnight rally on Wall Street driven by tech stocks.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Remain Elevated Around $110/Barrel, Posing Inflationary Risk for India
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices continue to hover around $110 per barrel due to escalating geopolitical tensions, which is a significant concern for India as it could increase import bills and fuel domestic inflation.

items.headline: Indian Hotels Reports Strong Q2 FY27 Performance with 19.4% Profit Growth
items.summary: Indian Hotels Company Ltd. announced a 19.4% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit to ₹380 crore for the September quarter, with revenue growing 21.7% to ₹2,484.3 crore.

items.headline: PC Jeweller Posts 58% Y-o-Y Profit Surge in September Quarter
items.summary: PC Jeweller Ltd. reported a significant 58% year-on-year rise in consolidated profit to ₹331.1 crore for the September quarter, alongside a 27.8% increase in revenue to ₹1,054.5 crore.

items.headline: Eternal (Zomato & Blinkit Parent) Misses Profit Estimates Due to Quick-Commerce Expansion
items.summary: Eternal, the parent company of Zomato and Blinkit, beat quarterly revenue estimates but reported a profit miss attributed to higher spending on expanding its quick-commerce business, Blinkit.

items.headline: Oil-Sensitive Stocks in Focus as Crude Oil Prices Surge
items.summary: Upstream oil companies like ONGC, Oil India, and Reliance Industries are expected to be active due to rising crude oil prices, which typically benefit producers but increase costs for OMCs and other fuel-dependent sectors.

items.headline: Jefferies Sees Valuation Gains in IT, Highlights Infosys, TCS, and Sagility
items.summary: The IT sector has seen a rally in October, with Jefferies identifying potential for further valuation gains in select stocks including Infosys and TCS, and recommending Sagility among mid-sized firms despite a muted long-term growth forecast for the sector.

items.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures New Orders Worth ₹1,011 Crore
items.summary: Bharat Electronics Ltd. has received additional orders totaling ₹1,011 crore since October 13, covering a range of equipment including radars, communication systems, sonar, and jammers, along with upgrades and services.

items.headline: Jio Platforms' $3.2 Billion IPO Fully Subscribed on Launch Day
items.summary: Jio Platforms' initial public offering, a $3.2 billion issue, was fully subscribed within hours of its launch, attracting significant interest from institutional investors.

items.headline: Zydus Lifesciences' Zylidac Bio Partners with Prolific Machines for Platform Scaling
items.summary: Zydus Lifesciences' biologics CDMO, Zylidac Bio, has entered into a partnership with Prolific Machines to scale its platform, signaling potential growth in its biologics segment.

items.headline: NHPC Unit 5 at Subansiri Lower Hydroelectric Project Commences Commercial Operation
items.summary: NHPC has announced the commercial operation date for Unit 5 (250 MW) of the Subansiri Lower Hydroelectric Project, adding to its operational capacity.
